Could not visually catch during run due to fast API response on the preview environment; CDP network throttling did not delay the timeline GET enough to observe.
test_results.backend_402_regression: PASS — POST /api/public/budget-calc {classification:4} with expired-trial bearer returns HTTP 402 with body detail.error='trial_expired', detail.message='Your trial has ended. Subscribe to continue.', detail.upgrade_url='/pricing'

critical_code_review_comments: ParticipantTimeline data-testid uses a non-URL-friendly id ('timeline-month-June 2026' contains a space). h2 id and aria-labelledby work but querySelector by id needs CSS.escape. Consider slugifying the id like the data-testid already does (timeline-month-june-2026). Not a blocker.
useExpiredTrial correctly hides banner for solo/family/adviser plans even when stale subscription_status='expired' lingers, matching brief §4.6. Good defensive fallback.
Timeline IntersectionObserver sentinel created without filtering on errored state — minor: if errored=true and tl=null, sentinelRef is null so observe() is skipped. Safe.
FloatingHelpChat: disabled state is correctly enforced on both textarea and send button. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 testable points; 2 empty-state branches not exercisable with current seed but code verified)

test_credentials: Used trial30909@example.com / TrialPass1! (expired-trial) and cathy@example.com / testpass123 (family) — both worked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 2 §4.5 (read-only banner), §4.7 (Ask Wayly disabled), and §10 (Timeline redesign) are fully verified at 100%. Empty-state branches (timeline-empty for brand-new accounts, timeline-empty-filtered when filter has no matches) were not visually exercised but code paths are correct. Login API returns token under key 'token' (NOT 'access_token'); localStorage key is 'kindred_token'. The timeline-month section id contains a space ('timeline-month-June 2026') — selectors must escape or use attribute matchers.
